entities.summary: Haitian Revolution, a transformative movement in Cuba (1763–1807). Emerged from Treaty of Paris returns Havana to Spain in exchange for Florida 1763 and British capture and occupation of Havana 1762. Catalyzed Sugar Boom and Slave Trade Expansion.
